category: SURFACE H - OpenAI integration and LLM provider seam
summary:
Code root: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-base (origin/main 683f56c0). Every LLM call uses the openai 3.3.1 AsyncOpenAI `chat.completions.create`. There are 15 dispatch sites, and all of them go through `api_budget_service.guarded_llm_create` (`store=False`, cost ledger, an optional breaker). The only other OpenAI surface is `moderations.create`. Nothing uses the Responses API or Structured Outputs (`json_schema`), and no code anywhere in app/ reads `finish_reason` or `refusal`. Six sites use JSON mode; the rest parse prose JSON after stripping a code fence. Vision input is a base64 data URI with `detail` set to `auto`. I verified the SDK surface against the pinned 3.3.1 source, which is installed in C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/.venv-qaren (the system Python has 2.21.0). I checked the Anthropic call shapes and model ids with context7 (/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python). The anthropic package is not installed or pinned.

The concrete flaws that map to the user's complaint ("camera can't spot products, pictures or info missing") and to the audit:
- (a) The vision prompt asks the model to guess products from shape, and the confidence it returns is never used afterwards (MYEZ-001).
- (b) "Unknown" / "Unknown Product" placeholder identities are created and then compared as if real (MYEZ-002).
- (c) If the vision reply is a JSON object instead of a bare array, it is silently turned into zero products.
- (d) A None or refusal reply crashes the camera route with a 500. A truncated verdict silently becomes the degraded verdict.
- (e) The Tier-3 image call can return invented or non-image URLs, because the validator only checks for an http(s) prefix (MYEZ-014).
- (f) Output language is only requested for the verdict, only behind the dark flag `ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT`, and the camera and URL routes never pass `lang` (MYEZ-016).
- (g) The URL extractor prompt forces a product shape onto any page, including homepages (MYEZ-005).
- (h) The targeted spec fill tells the model to use its training data, and the values are merged as if they were retrieved (MYEZ-003).

Existing dark flags already cover part of this: `ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT`, `ENABLE_SPECS_NO_FABRICATION`, `ENABLE_PRICE_FALLBACK_MAY_DECLINE`, `ENABLE_VERDICT_PROMPT_TRUTH`, `ENABLE_LLM_PREFLIGHT_BREAKER`. No flag exists for vision confidence or schema, the Tier-3 image grounding, the URL not-a-product check, or an Anthropic provider.

The proposed provider seam is a lazy adapter registry: `LLM_PROVIDER` (default `openai`), plus a new dark `ENABLE_ANTHROPIC_PROVIDER` that also requires `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` to be present. Any other selection fails closed with a typed `LLMProviderNotConfigured(LLMUnavailableError)`, which the camera route already maps to 503 `LLM_UNAVAILABLE`. With the provider unset, the OpenAI branch stays byte-identical, so the prompt-digest, `SHIPPED`-kwargs and `store` pins hold.

findings.title: Call-style inventory: chat.completions only, JSON mode on 6 sites, prose-JSON elsewhere, no Structured Outputs, no Responses API

evidence.note: openai==3.3.1 is pinned. httpx2==2.12.0 comes in 'via openai', alongside the app's own httpx==0.28.1.

`guarded_llm_create` is the single chat chokepoint. It forces `store=False` (980-983); with the breaker flag OFF it does a bare `client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)` (984-987); every served response is recorded on the cost ledger (986, 1032).
`response_format={'type':'json_object'}` on `extract_specs_targeted`, `extract_specs_synthesized` and `disambiguate_variant_line`.
JSON mode on the verdict, both the primary call and the fallback. The price fallback gets JSON mode only when `ENABLE_PRICE_FALLBACK_MAY_DECLINE` is ON.
The critic uses JSON mode and checks for empty content before `json.loads`. This is the best-validated site.
These sites parse prose JSON with a crude fence strip, `result.split('```')[1]`: parse, specs, price, price fallback, reviews. `classify_category_llm` reads plain text.

Vision sends `{type:'image_url', image_url:{url:'data:<mime>;base64,...', detail:'auto'}}` with `max_tokens` 500 and temperature 0 through `model_config` shims. It uses the import-time module `client`, not `get_client()`.

Shipped kwargs per site, per this pin: classify 10 tokens / T 0.0; parse 500/0.1; specs 1000/0.1; price 300/0.1; price fallback 200/0.2; reviews 600/0.2; targeted 200/0.1 (JSON); synth gpt-4o 300/0.1 (JSON); disambig 60/0 (JSON); image tier3 120/0.1; URL 800/0.1; critic 150/0.0 (JSON). The verdict is gpt-4o, 1000 tokens, T 0, JSON (fixture `verdict_kwargs`).

The pinned SDK's `ResponseFormat` union already includes `ResponseFormatJSONSchema`, so Structured Outputs is available on 3.3.1 but unused. `chat.completions.create` takes `max_completion_tokens`, `max_tokens`, `response_format`, `store` and `temperature` (resources/chat/completions/completions.py:263-284).

findings.detail: No call site anywhere in app/ uses `responses.create`, `chat.completions.parse` or `json_schema`. A grep for finish_reason / refusal / json_schema / `.parse(` / `responses.create` hits only the model_config.py docstring. JSON mode cannot return a bare array, which is why the vision call (which asks for an array) is unconstrained.

findings.title: Retry, timeout, 429 and breaker handling as shipped

evidence.note: There are two AsyncOpenAI builds: an import-time singleton and a memoised `get_client()`. Both use `httpx.Timeout(120.0, connect=30.0)` and `max_retries=openai_max_retries()`.

`extraction_service` has its own lazy client. The verdict falls back to the standard model when `str(exception)` contains '429', 'rate' or 'quota', using `with_options(max_retries=openai_fallback_max_retries())`. `classify_category_llm` is the only call wrapped in `asyncio.wait_for` (`CLASSIFY_LLM_TIMEOUT` 4.0 s).
`OPENAI_MAX_RETRIES` defaults to 2 (the SDK default). `OPENAI_FALLBACK_MAX_RETRIES` inherits it. `verdict_chain_max_attempts` = (1+max) + (1+fallback).
Recorded as done on Railway `web`: `OPENAI_MAX_RETRIES=1` and `OPENAI_FALLBACK_MAX_RETRIES=0`.

`ENABLE_LLM_PREFLIGHT_BREAKER` defaults OFF and is read per call. `LLMUnavailableError`'s message deliberately avoids the 429/rate/quota substrings. The transient classifier counts `RateLimitError`, `APIConnectionError` (which includes `APITimeoutError`), `InternalServerError`, 5xx and `TimeoutError`.
This is the only breaker row: default OFF, with no flip recorded. The row's line refs (:709/:712) have drifted; the code now has the def at 712 and the getenv at 715.

The pinned SDK retries every 429, including insufficient_quota and credit_balance_exhausted, unless the server sends `x-should-retry: false`. It also retries 408, 409 and 5xx. `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES=2` (_constants.py:8).
Camera: `LLMUnavailableError` or a transient SDK error becomes 503 `{code:'LLM_UNAVAILABLE'}`. Any other exception becomes a 500 with 'Image analysis failed'.

findings.detail: Prompt-level output language: the only directive is `_ARABIC_OUTPUT_DIRECTIVE` (extraction_service.py:2298), appended at 2581-2583. See the language finding.

findings.title: Vision prompt invites shape-only guesses, and the returned confidence is never consulted (MYEZ-001)

evidence.note: The prompt says: 'Identify products even WITHOUT packaging: use shape, color, logo, design cues (confidence="low")'.
`confidence` is passed through, defaulting to 'medium', and nothing validates it.
With two or more products the route auto-compares products[0] against products[1]. No confidence check happens; 'confidence' does not appear anywhere in image_routes.py.
Only brand, name and size_or_count reach the compare. Confidence is dropped.
The client downsizes every photo to 1024 px wide JPEG at compress 0.8 before upload. The default vision model is gpt-4o-mini (model_config `_ROLE_DEFAULTS`).

findings.detail: A low-confidence guess from bottle shape (the V04 watch and violin) becomes a product that gets compared and given a winner. Label OCR at 1024 px on gpt-4o-mini with `detail:auto` is a plausible cause of the 'camera can't spot products' complaint (inferred). The vision prompt also has no guidance for Arabic-script labels (e.g. AL IBDAA) or for transliteration; the name is returned however the model reads it (inferred risk for downstream search). An existing env-only knob, `OPENAI_MODEL_VISION`, can move vision to gpt-4o after a smoke test.

findings.title: Placeholder identities 'Unknown' / 'Unknown Product' are created and compared as real products (MYEZ-002)

evidence.note: `brand: p.get('brand') or 'Unknown'` and `name: p.get('name') or 'Unknown Product'`.
The vision pair builds a search query from the placeholder defaults.
The URL path sets `title = raw.get('title') or raw.get('full_title') or 'Unknown Product'`.

findings.detail: Missing fields are filled with literal placeholders instead of setting a needs-identification state. The pipeline then searches for and scores 'Unknown Product', which matches V09 (both cards 'Unknown Product' with a green winner). The fix should drop or flag placeholder entries before the compare, reusing the existing `action:'error'` / `need_second_product` camera shapes so the frozen contract is untouched.

findings.title: Vision parse silently drops a non-array JSON reply to zero products

evidence.note: The prompt demands a bare JSON array. After `json.loads`, `for p in (products if isinstance(products, list) else [])` throws away a `{"products":[...]}` object without a log line.
Zero products returns 'No products could be identified in the image(s). Try a clearer photo.' The user is blamed for a parser shape mismatch.
`p.get(...)` on a non-dict element (e.g. a string) raises AttributeError outside any try. The route turns it into a 500.

findings.detail: JSON mode cannot enforce an array, so the call runs unconstrained. The pinned SDK supports `json_schema` (completion_create_params.py:474), so a schema `{products:[{brand,name,size_or_count,visible_price,confidence,category}]}` with `strict` would remove this whole class of failure. How often models wrap the array in an object is not measured (inferred).

findings.title: No finish_reason or refusal handling anywhere: None content crashes vision with a 500; a truncated verdict silently degrades

evidence.note: In 3.3.1, `content: Optional[str]` and `refusal: Optional[str]`. `finish_reason` can be 'length' or 'content_filter' (types/chat/chat_completion.py:40).
`clean_json_response(raw_content)` calls `.strip()` on None, raising AttributeError outside the try. The camera route sees a non-transient error and returns 500.

The verdict is capped at 1000 tokens. `content.strip()` and `json.loads` run with no `finish_reason` check, and any failure returns `{'winner_index':0,'error':'verdict generation unavailable'}`, which is the degraded HTTP 200.
The Arabic directive asks for every prose field in MSA under the same 1000-token cap.

findings.detail: I infer that a 'length' cut-off of the JSON-mode verdict, which is more likely with Arabic prose, yields invalid JSON. That produces the degraded verdict with an empty 'why we chose' (V03 / MYEZ-017). No `finish_reason` is logged, so this cannot be confirmed from production logs today. Recommendation: log `finish_reason` and `refusal` at every site (additive, unflagged log-only), and treat 'length' on the verdict as a distinct, counted failure.

findings.title: Tier-3 image GPT can return fabricated or non-image URLs; the validator checks only the http(s) prefix (MYEZ-014)

evidence.note: The model is only shown page links and snippets (`- {link}: {snippet}`). No image URLs are given to it.
The prompt asks for a URL ending in .jpg/.png/.webp or 'a recognized image CDN URL'. 'Do not fabricate' is advisory only.

`_is_valid_image_url` accepts any string starting with http:// or https://. The candidate is never checked against the links it was given. `parsed.get` on a non-dict sits outside the local try (the orchestrator catches it).
The image leg's Phase-1 timeout is 5.0 s (Serper Images plus the Tier-3 GPT fallback).

findings.detail: A page URL or an invented URL is served as `image_url`, and the app then renders a broken or missing picture. I infer this contributes to 'the app doesn't show pictures sometimes'. Separately, Serper is dead by configuration on `web` (api_budget_service.py:633), so organic results are often absent and Tier 3 has nothing to choose from (inferred, a cross-surface matter). The fix belongs behind a new dark flag: accept only a URL that appears verbatim in the provided results' image fields, or drop the tier.

findings.title: Output language is requested only for the verdict, only when lang=ar plus a dark flag; camera and URL routes never pass lang (MYEZ-016)

evidence.note: `arabic_verdict_output_enabled()` reads `ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT`, and the directive is appended only when `output_lang == 'ar'`.
Flag row: MERGED #243, dark.
Says verdict, spec and review prose stays English, with `ENABLE_ARABIC_VERDICT_OUTPUT` dark. The S79 audit (APP_REVIEW_AUDIT_S79.md:309) lists its prod state as unverified.

`compare_from_text(query, region=region, vision_products=products, nocache=nocache)` passes no `output_lang`. A grep for 'lang' in image_routes.py and url_routes.py finds nothing; only text_routes.py:646/857/1108 pass it.

Every GCC_REGIONS entry has lang 'en'. `category_profile` labels are hardcoded English (`_CATEGORY_PROFILE_LABEL_OVERRIDES`). The specs, reviews, parse and classify prompts carry no language directive.

findings.detail: Even after the flag flips, camera and URL verdicts stay English. Spec and review prose and the profile labels are English in every path. A fix is additive: an optional `lang` on the camera form and query, and on the URL request, threaded as a conditional kwarg exactly like text_routes. That reaches phones only after an OTA, which is not allowed before approval. Translating the spec and review prose is a separate unit and needs a new flag.

findings.title: URL extraction prompt forces a product shape onto any page, including storefront homepages (MYEZ-005)

evidence.note: The schema requires `"name": "product name"`. There is no `is_product_page` field and no instruction to decline a homepage, category page or search page.
There is no `response_format`. The reply is parsed by fence strip plus `json.loads`, and any failure returns `{'error': str(e)}`.
A not-a-PDP classifier already exists (`ENABLE_NOT_A_PDP_FILTER`, default OFF), scoped to the price path. It is a candidate for reuse before the URL LLM call.

findings.detail: I infer that the fragrancex.com homepage (V02) yields an invented 'product', or an 'Unknown Product' via url_extraction_service.py:527. Recommend a dark-flagged pre-check that reuses the not-a-PDP rules, plus an `is_product_page` field in the prompt, mapped to the existing failure envelope.

findings.title: Targeted spec fill tells the model to use training data, but merges the values as if retrieved (MYEZ-003)

evidence.note: The prompt says: '- Use your training data as a fallback when snippets are silent'.
`_fill_one_field` returns `{field: val}` with no provenance or confidence marker. Tier 3 is the contrast: it is labelled `tier3_synthesis`, per openai_service.py:338-341.
`_no_fabrication_blocks_refill` is the existing veto under `ENABLE_SPECS_NO_FABRICATION`. That flag is OFF, with the precondition 'a working search layer' (CLAUDE.md flag rows).

findings.detail: With the flag OFF, invented spec values sit next to cited ones with no marker. The existing flag is the lever; do not add a new one. Its precondition (restored search) is outside this surface.

findings.title: Vision returns no category, does not dedupe, and nothing guards against a same-product pair (MYEZ-008, MYEZ-004)

evidence.note: The schema is brand, name, size_or_count, visible_price and confidence. There is no category even though the model sees the object, and no de-duplication.
The category is re-derived from the text name (`classify_category_from_text`). A grep for a same-product guard finds none.
size_or_count is appended to the name, and is then also sent as `variant` (structured_comparison_service.py:4221). The first two entries are compared even when they are identical.

findings.detail: I infer this explains beard oil scored on fragrance dimensions (V06) and 'GUESS GUESS! vs GUESS GUESS!' (V07). A vision `category` field is additive server-internal data. Dedupe and the same-pair refusal would reuse the existing `need_second_product` shape.

findings.title: Cost and usage reads hardcoded to gpt-4o-mini rates; a missing usage object crashes vision

evidence.note: `vision_cost` uses 0.15/0.60 per 1M whatever `OPENAI_MODEL_VISION` is set to. `usage.prompt_tokens` on a None usage raises AttributeError outside any try.
`disambiguate_variant_line` has the same hardcoded rates.
The compare-level cost also uses hardcoded mini rates. The authoritative per-model ledger is `openai_pricing.py` (PRICE_USD_PER_1M, lines 38-44).

findings.detail: This matters for the seam: an Anthropic adapter would be mispriced by these literals and by `record_openai_response`, which reads `prompt_tokens` / `completion_tokens` (openai_pricing.py:135-137). Anthropic reports `input_tokens` / `output_tokens`, so those calls would be recorded unpriced.

findings.title: Verdict fallback is keyed on exception substrings; quota 429s are retried and fall back to the same org

evidence.note: The fallback triggers on '429', 'rate' or 'quota' appearing in `str(primary_err).lower()`.
Every 429 is retried, including the permanent credit_balance_exhausted.
`RateLimitError` always counts as transient, quota included.

findings.detail: I infer that a credit-exhaustion 429 spends retries plus a fallback call that cannot succeed, and trips the breaker as if it were transient. String matching is also OpenAI-specific: an Anthropic 429 text or a 529 'overloaded' would not match. The seam should classify by typed error (status code and error type), not by message text.

findings.title: Vision call has no server-side wall; worst case exceeds the client's 120 s abort (MYEZ-015)

evidence.note: `await identify_products(...)` is not wrapped in `asyncio.wait_for`. The only 'timeout' hit in the file is a comment.
Per-attempt timeout is 120 s read and 30 s connect. With prod `OPENAI_MAX_RETRIES=1` (CLAUDE.md:578) that is up to about 240 s or more.
`IDENTIFY_TIMEOUT_MS = 120000`.

findings.detail: I infer that a slow vision attempt plus the compare that follows can outlast the client, which aborts as TIMEOUT while the server keeps spending. A bounded `wait_for` on vision, mapped to the existing 503 or TIMEOUT envelope, would be a dark-flag change.

findings.title: Model-literal allowlist and the pins an Anthropic placeholder must satisfy or extend

evidence.note: `_ROLE_DEFAULTS` is the single home of model ids: verdict gpt-4o, standard/vision/critic gpt-4o-mini, moderation omni-moderation-latest. Each is overridable per call through `OPENAI_MODEL_<ROLE>`.

The stray-literal pin: ALLOWED = {model_config.py, openai_pricing.py}. The regex only catches `gpt-*` and `omni-moderation-*`, and it globs app/services/*.py non-recursively. A `claude-*` literal would pass unpinned.

The M1 AST matcher only sees callees ending in `completions.create` or `guarded_llm_create`, so `messages.create` escapes it. M3 pins the exact kwargs per site. M4 pins `resolved_models()` to exactly the 5 OpenAI roles.

evidence.line: verdict_kwargs, synth_kwargs, targeted_kwargs, price_fallback_kwargs, url_extract_kwargs, image_tier3_kwargs, *_system, *_user
evidence.note: The prompt-fence digests (consumed by test_prompt_fence.py:392-404, test_model_config_enforced.py, test_prompt_truth.py and test_price_fallback_may_decline.py) hash both the prompt strings and the exact OpenAI kwargs, including `store:False`.
The client build may log only 'configured' or 'missing'. No 6-character substring of the key may appear in the logs.
The T02 dispatch rule's SDK_OBJECTS = {responses, batches, with_raw_response, with_streaming_response} plus chat.completions chains. `messages` is not listed.
`OpenAIIntegration(include_prompts=False)` and `send_default_pii=False`, pinned by tests/test_sentry_channels_u8d*.py. There is no Anthropic counterpart.

findings.detail: With `LLM_PROVIDER` unset, the seam must leave every OpenAI kwargs dict byte-identical, or the digest and M3 pins go red. Anthropic additions must add their own pins rather than loosen the existing ones.

findings.title: OpenAI-specific shapes the seam must absorb

evidence.note: These sites read `response.choices[0].message.content`, `usage.prompt_tokens`, `usage.completion_tokens` and `usage.total_tokens` (the 4o daily counter at 2703-2704).
Cache telemetry reads `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`. Vision uses the `image_url` data-URI part with `detail`. Several sites read `choices[0]`.
The breaker key is the constant 'openai'. The classifiers import `openai` exception classes. `store` and `extra_body` are OpenAI request fields.
L3/L4 call `client.moderations.create(model=moderation_model())` and read `results[0].flagged` / `.category_scores`, failing open on error.
`OPENAI_BASE_URL` only covers OpenAI-compatible endpoints and fails closed on a malformed value. The SCOPE note at 52-55 ('hardcoded at ~12 call sites') is stale.
An import-time AsyncOpenAI means OPENAI_API_KEY is required at boot (requirements.in:7-11), even if another provider is selected.

findings.detail: The session-69 decision memo already rejected the OpenAI-compatibility route to Anthropic (`OPENAI_BASE_URL`): it ignores `response_format`, has no moderation, and Claude 5 returns 400 on non-default temperature (LLM_PROVIDER_DECISION.md §4 B1; CLAUDE.md:588). A native adapter is required.

findings.title: SDK verification: openai 3.3.1 source read; the legacy httpx.Timeout the app passes is honoured

evidence.note: `__version__ = '3.3.1'`, matching the lock. The system Python312 has 2.21.0, which is not the pin.

`normalize_httpx_timeout` converts a legacy `httpx.Timeout` into `httpx2.Timeout(**value.as_dict())`. The app's `httpx.Timeout(120, connect=30)` is therefore honoured despite v3's httpx2 migration (context7 CHANGELOG 3.0.0).
APIStatusError, APIConnectionError, APITimeoutError(APIConnectionError), RateLimitError, InternalServerError and LengthFinishReasonError all exist as `api_budget_service` assumes.
`detail: Literal['auto','low','high']`.

findings.detail: The anthropic package is not in .venv-qaren or the lock, so its pinned behaviour is unmeasured. Anthropic shapes were checked via context7 /anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python (README examples, MIGRATION.md, types/model.py, message_create_params.py).

findings.title: Stale census and docs around the seam

evidence.note: The census lists `openai_service ... generate_comparison`. That function no longer exists in openai_service.py, which now has only identify_products, extract_specs_targeted, extract_specs_synthesized and disambiguate_variant_line.
Says model strings are still hardcoded at ~12 call sites. model_config owns them (B1-C19 in the S69 memo).
The docstring calls the SDK 'openai>=2.x' and mentions Anthropic/proxy flat fields. That is harmless, but the seam should own usage normalisation instead.

findings.detail: Documentation only; correct these in the seam PR.

recommendations: SEAM, new module (leave llm_provider.py alone; test_llm_provider_base_url.py pins it): add app/services/llm_adapter.py with a Protocol `LLMAdapter`. It has three async methods that take FINISHED prompt strings built by today's builders, so the prompt digests stay single-source: identify_products(images: list[{bytes,mime_type}], prompt: str, model: str, max_tokens: int) -> LLMResult; extract_json(system: str|None, user: str, model: str, max_tokens: int, temperature: float|None, json_mode: bool, schema: dict|None) -> LLMResult; verdict(system: str, user: str, model: str, max_tokens: int, temperature: float|None, client_override=None) -> LLMResult. LLMResult = {text: str|None, finish: 'stop'|'length'|'refusal'|'filtered', model: str, provider: str, usage: {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, total_tokens}}. OpenAIAdapter calls the existing `guarded_llm_create` with exactly today's kwargs. Migrate the call sites one at a time in later units; phase 1 changes no call site.

SELECTION RULE, read per call via `os.getenv` (house idiom). `selected_provider()`: `LLM_PROVIDER` unset, blank or 'openai' gives 'openai'. 'anthropic' gives AnthropicAdapter ONLY IF `ENABLE_ANTHROPIC_PROVIDER` (new, default OFF; no ANTHROPIC/LLM_PROVIDER flag exists in app/ or CLAUDE.md, measured by grep) is truthy AND `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is present (checked for presence only, never logged). Every other combination, including a typo, raises `LLMProviderNotConfigured`. It must never fall back silently to OpenAI; this mirrors llm_provider.py:25-32, where a mistyped routing must not send prompts to the vendor the operator meant to leave.

ERROR TYPING: `class LLMProviderNotConfigured(LLMUnavailableError)` in api_budget_service (or re-exported there). Its message must avoid '429', 'rate' and 'quota' (api_budget_service.py:702-709) so the verdict fallback cannot fire on it. As a subclass it already maps to 503 LLM_UNAVAILABLE on the camera (image_routes.py:324-328). For the text and stream paths, OR a `provider_not_configured()` check into `_llm_preflight_short_circuits()` (structured_comparison_service.py:1724-1737), independent of the breaker flag, so a misconfigured provider stops before scraping with the existing LLM_UNAVAILABLE envelope (3952-3953) instead of a degraded 200. That is byte-identical while `LLM_PROVIDER` is unset.

ANTHROPIC CALL SHAPE (context7 /anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python: examples/images.py, MIGRATION.md, types/model.py, message_create_params.py): `await AsyncAnthropic(api_key=..., max_retries=openai_max_retries()-equivalent, timeout=...).messages.create(model='claude-haiku-5-5', max_tokens=N, system=SYSTEM_STR, messages=[{'role':'user','content':[{'type':'image','source':{'type':'base64','media_type':'image/jpeg','data':B64}}, {'type':'text','text':PROMPT}]}], output_config={'format':{'type':'json_schema','schema':SCHEMA}})`. The system prompt is the top-level `system=` argument, never a message. Send NO temperature: the current SDK removed temperature/top_p/top_k from messages.create, and the S69 memo B2-C7 documents a 400 on non-default sampling for Claude 5. `sampling_kwargs()` must therefore return {} for `claude-*` ids. Thinking: Claude 5 has thinking on by default and it counts toward max_tokens (memo B1-C8 / B2-C7); the `thinking` and `output_config.effort` params exist. Parse: take the `text` blocks of `message.content` and skip thinking blocks. Map `stop_reason` 'max_tokens' to 'length' and 'refusal' to 'refusal'. Usage: input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens, and output_tokens.

MODEL IDS: add `_ANTHROPIC_ROLE_DEFAULTS` to model_config.py (the allowlisted home), overridable through `ANTHROPIC_MODEL_<ROLE>`: suggested standard/vision/critic 'claude-haiku-5-5', verdict 'claude-sonnet-5-5', with 'claude-opus-5-5' available by env. All three ids appear in the SDK's Model literal (context7 types/model.py). Keep `resolved_models()` returning exactly the 5 OpenAI roles (test_model_config_enforced.py:270-275) and add a separate `resolved_anthropic_models()`. Leave moderation on OpenAI `omni-moderation-latest` (free; content_safety_service.py:249-252). OPENAI_API_KEY stays required in any case because of the import-time client (openai_service.py:33-37).

PINS TO EXTEND in the placeholder PR: (1) test_model_config.py:135, widen the regex to `claude-[a-z0-9.\-]+` with ALLOWED still {model_config.py, openai_pricing.py} (plus an anthropic price module if one is added).
